records.translation: Itinuturo sa iyo ang wikang Duwende.

records.source: A resinous substance found near the surface.
records.translation: Sangkap na mala-dagta na matatagpuan malapit sa ibabaw.

records.source: A thick, slimy goop that the Wizard wants for some reason.
records.translation: Malapot at madulas na sangkap na gusto ng Mago sa hindi malamang dahilan.
Mahaba at madulas na munting isda.

records.source: A rich and wholesome relative of the tomato. Delicious fried or stewed.
records.translation: Malinamnam at masustansiyang kamag-anak ng kamatis. Masarap iprito o ilaga.

records.englishResidueReason: Parmesan is the conventional borrowed culinary name for the cheese and this specific dish style.

records.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 5 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa taglagas. Tumatagal ng 5 araw upang mahinog at patuloy na namumunga matapos ang unang ani.

records.englishResidueReason: Elf is retained as the distinct fantasy people name so it is not confused with the game's dwarves.

records.source: Dirty but still beautiful. On the side is a flowing script thought by some to be the ancient language of the elves. No Elvish bones have ever been found.
records.translation: Marumi ngunit maganda pa rin. Sa gilid ay may masining na sulat na inaakala ng ilan na sinaunang wika ng mga Elf. Wala pang natatagpuang buto ng Elf.
records.englishResidueReason: Elf is retained as the distinct fantasy people name so it is not confused with the game's dwarves.

records.source: A precious stone with a brilliant green color.
records.translation: Mahalagang bato na may maningning na berdeng kulay.
Pinatataas nang 10% ang bilis ng sandata.
Basagin upang makakuha ng mga esmeralda.

records.source: Place on a sprinkler and load with fertilizer to automatically apply it when planting seeds nearby.
records.translation: Ikabit sa Awtomatikong Pandilig at lagyan ng pataba upang awtomatikong ilapat ito kapag nagtatanim ng mga binhi sa malapit.

records.preserveReason: Escargot is the conventional borrowed culinary name for this specific French snail dish.

records.translation: Mga susong binabad sa mantikilya at niluto nang perpekto.

records.preserveReason: Esperite is the proper mineral specimen name used by the game's museum collection.

records.source: The crystals glow bright green when stimulated.
records.translation: Kumikinang nang matingkad na berde ang mga kristal kapag napukaw.

records.source: Sprinkle on kegs, furnaces, and other refining equipment to instantly receive their product.
records.translation: Ibudbod sa mga bariles, pugon, at iba pang kagamitang pamproseso upang agad makuha ang produkto ng mga ito.

records.source: An old folk legend suggests that the sweet smell of this flower attracts fairies.
records.translation: Ayon sa matandang alamat, nakaaakit ng mga diwata ang matamis na halimuyak ng bulaklak na ito.

records.source: Plant in fall. Takes 12 days to produce a mysterious flower. Assorted Colors.
records.translation: Itanim sa taglagas. Tumatagal ng 12 araw upang magpatubo ng mahiwagang bulaklak. Iba't ibang kulay.

records.source: An old miner's song suggests these are made from the bones of ancient fairies.
records.translation: Ayon sa matandang awit ng minero, gawa ang mga ito sa mga buto ng sinaunang diwata.
